channel.desc: Donnavan grew up believing the man who raised him was his father, but when his mother, Constance, revealed that Ben is his biological father, Donnavan was left questioning everything, and, while Ben is heartbroken over missing out on Donnavan's life, he wants nothing more than to build a real relationship with his son; in just two years, Janina and Nia went from being best friends to demanding each other's phones be unlocked; both admit they played a role in how things spiraled.
